events.body: TG-4307 dispatched with Quillmoor Arc as DL-9945. Service: home delivery, charged to the customer at our checkout at 14.50. For reference, delivery charges on our orders are ours; any refund of one is decided by Refunds team, Sedgemoor Goods, on evidence of a service failure.
DL-9945 attempted 13:20 today. Driver note: no access, carded. Held at Destination depot. Next re-delivery slot on that route is 16 May.

For the record. I was at home throughout 10 May. No card was left. My door camera shows no vehicle between 12:00 and 15:00. As the next slot offered was six days away I drove to your depot this morning and collected DL-9945 myself: a round trip of 38 miles. I should like the attempt examined.

Please review the 10 May 12:20 stop for DL-9945. The recipient, Isolde Eckersall, says he was home, no card was left and his camera shows no vehicle. He has since collected the parcel from the depot himself. Please confirm what the route record shows.

DL-9945 reviewed. Stop GPS for 10 May 12:20 places the driver at Harrow Fold Lane. The delivery address is Harrow Fold Close. The attempt was made at the wrong location and no card was left at the correct address. Quillmoor Arc accepts that the failed delivery was our error. This finding has been sent to the recipient in writing today.

Copied to the Rivet Delivery Desk. Dear Mr Eckersall, we are sorry for the failed delivery of DL-9945. Under our conditions of carriage Quillmoor Arc does not pay recipients' travel costs or other consequential losses. The delivery charge was set and collected by the sender, not by us, and we hold none of it. This is Quillmoor Arc's final response on compensation.

I now hold two letters and I invite you to read them side by side. (1) Your carrier's investigators, 13 May: 'The attempt was made at the wrong location... Quillmoor Arc accepts that the failed delivery was our error.' (2) Your carrier's customer relations, 17 May: no compensation, final response. So fault is admitted in terms and the remedy for it is nil. Remarkable. I paid 14.50 for delivery to my home. That service was not performed; I performed it, over 38 miles, in my own car. I require written confirmation from you by 17:00 tomorrow that the 14.50 and my mileage will be refunded. A further apology will not be treated as a response. I have had three.
